summary.text: SUBMARA SURVEY VEST AS is a private limited company registered in Øvre Ervik, founded 2011-03-20. SUBMARA SURVEY VEST AS provides consulting services in construction and civil engineering, including surveying and mapping and geological investigations, as well as construction engineering consulting and related activities. It was previously named VESETH AS until 2026-11-03. Its main industry code is 71.121: civil engineering activities. The register shows 19 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 27 480 137 NOK and the annual result was 1 493 903 NOK; operating income was up from 21 165 827 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 585 299 NOK in 2024 to 1 493 903 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 3 946 705 NOK in 2024 to 1 853 761 NOK in 2025. The registered employee count went from 20 on 2025-11-13 to 19 on 2026-10-14. Recent changes in the register: name set to SUBMARA SURVEY VEST AS on 2026-11-03.
